what: SAMPLE rows for the Strategy Lab view (tools/build_strategy_lab.py) until research/lab/popular_ict.json and popular_classic.json land. Not results: the numbers are placeholders in the real files' shape, and the pages show a SAMPLE banner.

strategies.name: SAMPLE · ICT Silver Bullet
rules: 10:00-11:00 ET only: a liquidity sweep, then a fair value gap in the new direction.
Entry on the return into the FVG.
Stop past the sweep; target the opposite liquidity.

strategies.name: SAMPLE · ICT Judas swing
rules: A false move at the NY open into a session high or low.
Entry on the market structure shift back.
Stop past the false move; target the other side of the range.

strategies.name: SAMPLE · ICT OTE retracement
rules: A displacement leg, then a 62-79% retracement (the OTE zone).
Entry inside the zone on a 1m shift.
Stop past the leg's start; target the leg's extreme and beyond.

strategies.name: SAMPLE · Opening range breakout
rules: The first 15 minutes after 09:30 ET set the range.
Entry on a 5m close outside it.
Stop at the range's other side; target 2R.

strategies.name: SAMPLE · VWAP 2-sigma reversion
rules: Price stretches 2 standard deviations from the session VWAP.
Entry on the first 5m close back inside the band.
Stop past the stretch extreme; target VWAP.

strategies.name: SAMPLE · RSI(2) pullback
rules: Trend filter: price above the 200 EMA (1h).
Entry when RSI(2) drops under 10 on the 5m.
Exit when RSI(2) is back over 70; stop 1.5 ATR.
